page.layout: Title block at the top, full width (three lines plus a fourth line in italic). Below it three columns in reading order: left column (A, C, D, E), middle column (Excelsa, F, I, L, M, P), right column (R, S, T, V). "FINIS." centred below the columns. Woodcut initial A at the start of the left column. No margin notes. No running head or page number.

main_text.l: Mandata diuina an in hac vita ferua-

page.notes: The woodcut initial A stands before "Adoratio hominum" (first entry, left column); the printed line shows only "Doratio", so the word is joined to the initial. The left-column letter E is a small heading, and "Excelsa" at the top of the middle column is set apart from the other E entries; both are kept as printed. "Asylorum" is printed "Afylorum", with long s. Long s is written as plain s throughout. Printed "&" written as & in XML. The entry "Mandata diuina ... ferua-" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. No page number or running head is printed.
